_rationale: 10K is scene-first and uses brand/manifest.md, not impeccable's DESIGN.md, so designSystem drift checks (design-system-font/color/radius) are disabled. overused-font and single-font are ignored because they conflict with the design-intelligence corpus font recommendations under the scene discipline (see blueprints/05-craft-and-bans.md). Every objective anti-pattern (contrast, side-stripe/border-accent, gradient-text, glassmorphism-default, hero metric, identical card grids, eyebrow/numbered scaffolding, text-overflow, cramped padding, low-contrast, line-length, monotonous spacing) stays ENABLED.
